text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the trio meet at the
runners' tunnel
to celebrate their
performance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Rickey, Acute! I went all out today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I managed to use every ounce of my
strength! I'm
back to my old self... No,
I've gotten even better!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You two were incredible out there. But I
threw in
a little of the wisdom I've
accumulated over the
years.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are tons of different ways to run.
I'll show
you even more of them from
here on out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The cheering—it's still going. And this
feeling of
satisfaction in me...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I can sense it. This space is full. In
perfect
harmony.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My running, our running—this is the Four

Guardians in balance. Each one
mighty—each one
equal!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I may have stumbled along the way, but
now I've
made it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui helped me better myself. It
helped me
help others, and it brought us
to a place where we
can all compete
with smiles on our faces.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now, I can show the world the power of
feng shui!
I can make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tiiing, tiiing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? That sound just now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That was the roar of the Azure Dragon.
A roar of
joy, coming from... my heart?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's not the Azure Dragon!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's a different dragon! That must mean...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd be satisfied once I got
here...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But now, I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Copano Rickey tells
me she
wants to discuss a matter of
grave importance.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? I've mentioned this
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember me talking about the
dragons
of feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not the one I want to talk
about today.
In the world of feng shui...
choice_data_list_en: When you say dragon, do you mean the Azure Dragon?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are two dragons. I'm talking about
the
other one.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Yellow Dragon.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Its existence is above the Four
Guardians. Seated
quietly at their
center, it is believed to be the
ruler of
all creation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've believed in
the blessing
of the Azure Dragon. I've
always wanted to
become just like it. But
now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've realized that, deep down, that might
not be
enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've started wanting to become like the
Yellow
Dragon.
choice_data_list_en: Then your true feelings right now are...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like I want to become stronger than
Tarumae and
Acute. The feeling started
small, but it just keeps
growing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fate is not yet written. Both Tarumae
and Acute
are strong. But I...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I must surpass them, and become even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but give in to this feeling. It's
like a
duty I have to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's eyes are dead serious. I
might
not know what prompted her to
feel this way, but
what I do know...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...is that the Twinkle Series is a
competition to see
who's the fastest. It's
not a place where you aim
to be equal,
but to rise above.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The dirt champion... If I want to earn
that
reputation, then...
choice_data_list: 目指すしかないな、ダート王者を
目指すしかないね、ダート王者を
choice_data_list_en: Guess we've got no choice but to aim for Dirt Champion.
Only one thing to do: aim for Dirt Champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten is a year-end race
held at
Oi Racecourse. It'll be the
perfect venue to hold a
grand
showdown.
choice_data_list: 『東京大賞典』で完勝しよう、2人に
choice_data_list_en: Let's score a decisive victory over both of them at the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Attaining victory there would leave no
doubt in
anyone's mind that Copano
Rickey is this year's
best runner on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten... You're right. I
want to win
it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I want to win it and stand at the very top! I want to reach the pinnacle—the taiji itself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved harmony, Copano
Rickey
prepares to take her next leap
forward. Her next
goal is now clear.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's so much that I've yet to achieve.
But the
first step...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...is winning the Tokyo Daishoten. With
our
combined effort, Trainer, and with
the power of
feng shui!
